title: Social Skills in the Workplace
overview: A growing segment of professionals acknowledges that achieving success in the workplace necessitates not only technical expertise but also personal and social skills. This course emphasizes several crucial personal and social skills, often considered a significant component of success. By offering insights on averting burnout, enhancing personal and professional focus, establishing a professional network, fostering connections with colleagues, and refining social competencies, the course aims to augment participants' technical skill set. Many management experts assert that success in a corporate setting relies more on behavioral skills than technical ones. The objective of this course is to equip you with practical techniques and tools for enhancing these essential skills.
audience: Administrators, officers, specialists, supervisors, team leaders, and line managers.
methodology: Skill development necessitates an interactive and participatory hands-on approach. Participants will engage in self-assessment of current practices and formulate action plans to enhance their behaviors.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Navigate the evolving rules of work, learning, and life
Spot early signs of burnout and formulate a recovery strategy
Utilize established techniques to heighten focus in the workplace
Build and sustain your professional network
Realize the advantages of connecting with others through defined behaviors
Evaluate your existing social skills and create a personal development plan
Enumerate and employ established strategies for influencing and persuading others within organizations
